name: @digitable/functions
description: The trusted Cloud Functions authority (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ADR-001 layout). Phase 2 PR 3 hosts the operable callable admission/join boundary here — admitMember and claimSeat wrap @digitable/engine's pure admission decisions and secret hashing in one Firestore transaction, behind Firebase Auth, App Check monitoring, and per-IP/per-room-code throttling. Phase 2 PR 4 adds the gameplay command authority to the same codebase.
